purpose: Machine-readable planning contract for visual placement, movement and turn-transition use of damage counters in the restored Stream Bandit Battle Client, aligned with canonical vitality/damage and precision-execution semantics.

counter_model.visible_counter_values: 10-point increments constrained by the exact amount mode and remaining legal amount declared by the resolving effect or property

amount_precision.fixed_amount: If the effect declares a fixed amount, the full legal amount must be selected/applied; the player may not voluntarily choose less merely to reach a preferred damage total.
amount_precision.up_to_amount: If the effect explicitly says up to N, the player may select a smaller legal amount including zero when the underlying operation allows zero/no action.
amount_precision.allow_partial: Partial movement/placement is legal only when the structured operation explicitly allows it, such as allow_partial=true or an equivalent up-to amount mode.
amount_precision.available_source_limit: MOVE_DAMAGE can never remove more damage than actually exists on the source, even when the declared maximum is larger.
amount_precision.ui_requirement: The counter tray must distinguish fixed required total from optional/up-to remaining total.

operation_level_defeat_boundary.rule: Every committed PLACE_DAMAGE or MOVE_DAMAGE operation runs the destination defeat check immediately after the placement/state update and before later listeners, follow-up target selection, or effects are allowed to act on that destination.
operation_level_defeat_boundary.reason: A Creature made lethal by counter placement/movement must leave play before subsequent logic can treat it as a legal in-play target.

turn_transition_condition_counters.description: A turn-based Condition may declare damage counters that are added at the canonical turn-switch/checkup checkpoint.

acceptance_examples: PLACE_DAMAGE fixed 30: legal distribution must total exactly 30 in 10-point increments before commit, then run the immediate defeat boundary.
MOVE_DAMAGE fixed 50: if 50 can legally be moved, the player must move exactly 50; a smaller amount is not a legal voluntary choice.
MOVE_DAMAGE up to 50 or allow_partial=true: show legal 10-point choices up to the lower of 50 and available source damage; smaller legal totals are allowed.

condition says place 10 damage at each turn switch: animate one 10 counter at every canonical turn-transition checkpoint while the Condition remains active, immediately check defeat, then resolve consequences before normal play.
